node.title: PMA sigma-one index-two four-defect core owner
node.statement: For every listed codeword, canonically owning the first index-two coset with at most four missed agreements and retaining only enough outside agreements to reach k interpolation points gives a chart-independent injective owner. On all 128 official sigma=1 rows this class has global size below Q_2(k+2); combined with the exact-periodic owner it fits below 8(1+2^-690)Q_2(k+2), hence inside the existing 719 line. The reciprocal-quadratic Omega(n^7) per-sunflower obstruction is contained in this owner.
